example_1: The lease shall be valid for a period of 11 months commencing from [Start_Date].
example_2: This agreement is for 11 months starting from [Start_Date] with no automatic renewal.
instruction: Clause defining the duration of the lease.

example_1: The Lessee shall pay a rent of Rs. [Rent_Amount]/- every month on or before the 5th.
example_2: Monthly rental of Rs. [Rent_Amount]/- is to be paid via NEFT to the Lessor's account.
instruction: Clause specifying the monthly rent and due date.

example_1: The Lessee agrees to pay Rs. [Deposit_Amount]/- as a security deposit refundable upon termination.
example_2: A sum of Rs. [Deposit_Amount]/- is taken as interest-free refundable deposit.
instruction: Clause about the security deposit amount and refund conditions.

example_1: The premises shall be used only for residential purposes and not for any business activity.
example_2: The leased unit must be used as a residence and not for running a business.
instruction: Clause specifying usage of the premises.

example_1: Lessee shall be responsible for day-to-day maintenance of the premises.
example_2: Minor repairs like leaking taps are to be handled by the tenant.
instruction: Clause about who is responsible for maintenance.

example_1: Lessee shall not sublet or license the premises without Lessor's written consent.
example_2: Subleasing without permission will be deemed a breach of contract.
instruction: Clause restricting subletting or reassignment.

example_1: Either party may terminate the lease by giving a notice of [Notice_Period] days.
example_2: A notice period of [Notice_Period] days is mandatory before vacating.
instruction: Clause on termination rights of either party.

example_1: Rent may be revised by up to 10% after completion of 11 months.
example_2: Rent escalation will occur at 8% annually on mutual consent.
instruction: Clause on periodic rent revision conditions.

example_1: The lease shall have a lock-in period of 6 months during which termination is not allowed.
example_2: Tenant shall not terminate the lease before 6 months except under emergency.
instruction: Clause defining lock-in restrictions for early exit.

example_1: Failure to vacate the property on time shall result in a penalty of Rs. 500 per day.
example_2: Delay in handing over possession after lease ends will incur Rs. 1000 per day.
instruction: Clause specifying penalty for delayed handover or overstay.

example_1: All internal repairs shall be undertaken by the Lessee at their own cost.
example_2: The Lessee shall keep the premises in good working condition during lease.
instruction: Clause assigning responsibility for internal repairs.

example_1: Lessee shall pay all electricity, water, gas, and internet bills during tenancy.
example_2: All utility connections shall be transferred to the Lessee during tenancy.
instruction: Clause covering utility and amenity bill responsibility.

example_1: Property tax shall be paid solely by the Lessor during the lease period.
example_2: Taxes levied by local authorities shall be borne by the owner.
instruction: Clause assigning responsibility for property tax.

example_1: The Lessor shall be allowed to inspect the premises with 24-hour notice.
example_2: Owner can enter the property with 48 hours’ notice for inspection.
instruction: Clause granting landlord access to inspect the property.

example_1: No pets shall be kept in the premises without prior approval from the Lessor.
example_2: Any pet in the premises requires written approval and vaccination certificate.
instruction: Clause defining rules on keeping pets.

example_1: Visitors are not allowed to stay overnight without informing the Lessor.
example_2: Guests can stay up to 7 days only, else charges apply.
instruction: Clause defining visitor duration or overnight stay rules.

example_1: No structural modifications shall be done by Lessee without written permission.
example_2: Painting, drilling, or interior works are not allowed without consent.
instruction: Clause about alteration or modification permissions.

example_1: The Lessee shall insure their personal belongings at their own discretion.
example_2: Tenant is responsible for insurance of personal electronics and valuables.
instruction: Clause about insurance requirements for tenant.

example_1: Lessee shall ensure that fire safety guidelines are followed at all times.
example_2: Basic fire extinguishers shall be provided and maintained by the Lessee.
instruction: Clause about adherence to fire safety standards.

example_1: Lessor may evict the Lessee upon serious breach of lease terms.
example_2: Eviction shall be processed if illegal activity is reported at the premises.
instruction: Clause outlining grounds for eviction.

example_1: Furniture provided by the Lessor must be maintained in original condition.
example_2: Lessee is liable for damage to sofas, beds, or electronics provided by Lessor.
instruction: Clause regarding furnished apartment care and maintenance.

example_1: Security deposit shall be refunded within 30 days of lease termination after deductions.
example_2: Deposit return shall be made after inspection and deductions, if any.
instruction: Clause for returning deposit with deductions.

example_1: A 30-day notice is required by either party to terminate the agreement.
example_2: Lessee must provide [Notice_Period] days’ notice for leaving the property.
instruction: Clause requiring notice for early exit.

example_1: Lessor retains the right to access the premises for urgent repairs with prior notice.
example_2: Emergency access must be granted to owner in case of water/gas leak.
instruction: Clause on emergency access to the leased premises.

example_1: Loud music or gatherings after 10 PM are strictly prohibited.
example_2: Any loud music disturbing neighbors will invite written warnings.
instruction: Clause restricting excessive noise or disturbance.

example_1: Lessee may use common areas like terrace and parking as per society rules.
example_2: Common amenities shall be used as per RWA guidelines only.
instruction: Clause on use of shared society facilities.

example_1: Garbage must be disposed of regularly and not accumulated in corridors.
example_2: Improper garbage disposal may lead to fines from the housing society.
instruction: Clause about proper disposal of garbage.

example_1: Water usage should be restricted to domestic purposes only.
example_2: Using borewell or unauthorized plumbing shall be deemed a violation.
instruction: Clause on water usage limitations or standards.

example_1: Electricity consumption beyond 300 units shall be borne additionally by Lessee.
example_2: Excess power usage shall be adjusted against monthly rental bill.
instruction: Clause describing electricity billing arrangement.

example_1: Lease may be renewed upon mutual agreement for an additional 11 months.
example_2: On expiry, a fresh lease agreement must be executed if extended.
instruction: Clause for renewal of agreement after lease period.

example_1: All keys shall be returned to the Lessor on termination without duplication.
example_2: Lessee must return all duplicate keys and get acknowledgement.
instruction: Clause on returning original keys to landlord.

example_1: Lessee is allowed parking for one car only in designated area.
example_2: No more than one vehicle is allowed per flat in parking.
instruction: Clause outlining vehicle parking terms.

example_1: Lessor shall ensure round-the-clock security through CCTV and guards.
example_2: Surveillance shall be conducted at entry and exit points of the property.
instruction: Clause about security arrangements by landlord.

example_1: Lessee must keep premises clean and hygienic during the tenancy.
example_2: Lessee must not create unhygienic or hazardous living conditions.
instruction: Clause on tenant's cleanliness and hygiene responsibilities.

example_1: Lessor has the right to inspect the flat once every quarter.
example_2: Owner may request quarterly walkthrough of the flat to ensure upkeep.
instruction: Clause about scheduled inspections by landlord.

example_1: The premises shall comply with all municipal and regulatory standards.
example_2: Lessee must get approval for any changes to layout from municipality.
instruction: Clause ensuring municipal/legal compliance of property.

example_1: Commercial use of premises is strictly prohibited and leads to termination.
example_2: Running shops or tuition classes in the apartment is banned.
instruction: Clause banning commercial activities on residential premises.

example_1: Lessee shall be liable for damage caused due to negligence.
example_2: Tenant must compensate for any broken fittings or cracked tiles.
instruction: Clause stating liability for damages by tenant.

example_1: Fire exits shall not be blocked or obstructed at any time.
example_2: No storage near fire exits shall be permitted by society.
instruction: Clause mandating clear fire escape access.

example_1: In case of default in rent for 2 consecutive months, eviction may be initiated.
example_2: Repeated defaults may be recorded and lease cancelled after due process.
instruction: Clause defining default and termination on missed payments.

example_1: Disputes shall be first resolved through mediation and then legal recourse.
example_2: Conflicts will be first handled via mutual discussion before legal notice.
instruction: Clause for resolving disputes through mediation.

example_1: This Agreement shall be governed by laws applicable in the State of Delhi.
example_2: The courts of Delhi shall have exclusive jurisdiction over all matters.
instruction: Clause about legal jurisdiction of disputes.

example_1: All provisions shall be interpreted in accordance with Indian Contract Act.
example_2: This agreement follows provisions of Transfer of Property Act and Rent Control Acts.
instruction: Clause stating applicable legal framework.

example_1: This lease constitutes the entire agreement between both parties.
example_2: No previous verbal commitments shall override this written agreement.
instruction: Clause affirming complete understanding of agreement.

example_1: This agreement shall also bind heirs, successors, and legal representatives.
example_2: In case of death, nominee or heir must honor the lease conditions.
instruction: Clause binding agreement on legal successors.

example_1: Any amendment shall be in writing and signed by both parties.
example_2: Changes to terms will not be valid unless agreed in writing.
instruction: Clause stating conditions for valid amendments.

example_1: This agreement shall be executed in English only.
example_2: Only English version of this lease shall be admissible in disputes.
instruction: Clause specifying language of execution.

example_1: Notices shall be served via registered post or email.
example_2: Electronic mail and courier are valid means of service of notice.
instruction: Clause on official means of communication.

example_1: If the property is sold, this lease stands terminated with 2 months’ notice.
example_2: Owner shall notify the Lessee if sale is intended 60 days in advance.
instruction: Clause allowing termination if property is sold.

example_1: Neither party shall be held liable for events beyond their control (Force Majeure).
example_2: Flood, earthquake, or war-like events shall be considered Force Majeure.
instruction: Clause excusing liability under uncontrollable events.
